description: Arcmira indexes podcasts, interviews, YouTube videos, and other long-form spoken media into a searchable graph of entities, mentions, sponsors, and transcripts. It provides search, transcript retrieval, monitors, and related research tools over web, API, and MCP interfaces.
summary: Arcmira exposes a bearer-authenticated HTTP JSON API at `api.arcmira.com/v1`, an OAuth-or-bearer remote MCP server at `mcp.arcmira.com/mcp`, a public documentation MCP server at `arcmira.com/docs/mcp`, and an `arcmira` CLI distributed via npm.
